info.name: AppDynamics Alert and Respond Actions Health Rules Export/Import API
Export health rules for an application

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID of the business application.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of a specific health rule to export. If omitted, all health rules are exported.

items.docs: Exports all health rules for the specified application as an XML document. The exported configuration can be imported into another application or Controller instance.

info.name: Import health rules for an application

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID of the business application.

params.name: overwrite
params.description: When true, overwrites existing health rules with matching names.

items.docs: Imports health rule configurations from an XML file into the specified application. Existing health rules with matching names can be overwritten.
